title: ICSI CSEET October 2026 Session Results Declared on November 11, 2026!
content:
# ICSI CSEET October 2026 Session Results Declared on November 11, 2026!

Ek important update hai for all aspiring Company Secretaries! The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) ne Company Secretary Executive Entrance Test (CSEET) – October 2026 session ke results announce kar diye hain. Candidates can check their performance now.

*   **Result Declaration Date:** The results for the CSEET October 2026 session were declared on **November 11, 2026**.
*   **How to Check Results:** Candidates can access their e-Result-cum-Marks Statement on the official ICSI website (icsi.edu) by logging in with their registration number and date of birth.
*   **Important Note:** ICSI will not issue any physical copy of the Result-cum-Marks Statement. The e-statement downloaded from the website will be the final document.
*   **Passing Criteria:** To qualify, candidates need to score a minimum of 40% marks in each of the four papers and an aggregate of 50% marks in total.
*   **Examination Period:** The CSEET October 2026 examination was conducted on October 1, 3, 5, and 6, 2026.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://www.icsi.edu/examination/results)

*Published on: 12 November 2026*
